sponsor_or_proposer: National Gas Company of Trinidad and Tobago (NGC) with Globus Energy Group Trinidad Ltd, Corban Energy Group, Chester LNG LLC
current_state: MOU signed May 2023 to 'identify and screen technologies for micro and small-scale LNG development projects' to supply the wider Caribbean from Trinidad gas reserves. No site named, no capacity disclosed, no FEED/FID/permit since. A 2026 search for a follow-on announcement returned only the same 2023 MOU coverage — no evidence of progress in three years.
missing_threshold_elements: No approximate site/location within Trinidad; no capacity; no concrete step beyond the exploratory MOU (no FEED, tender, or permit).
watch_for: A named site (existing NGC/Atlantic LNG estate at Point Fortin vs. elsewhere), a capacity figure, or a FEED/FID announcement.
notes: Distinct from (and not to be confused with) the Sept-2024 'Caribbean's first low-carbon bunkering HUB' MOU among Trinidad state agencies (nationalenergy.tt) — that is marine LNG/fuel bunkering and is out of scope per the discovery SOP's bunkering exclusion (confirmed via mid-task correction from orchestrator), not evaluated further. Also distinct from the Loran-Manatee/Dragon cross-border gas fields (Shell/BP), which are upstream backfill-gas supply for the EXISTING Atlantic LNG Terminal (T100000130579) via pipeline, not a new terminal — no discovery action, this is Update/Source-field territory if not already reflected.
